metadata.description: NVIDIA DLSS 5 Neural Rendering (+ DLSS Super Resolution) for video. Drives the worker from Merserk's 'DLSS 5 Visual Enhancer' (point runtime_dir at its bin\runtime folder) or the bundled DLSS5-for-Nuke worker. Windows + RTX only.

settings.description: Folder of your unzipped 'DLSS 5 Visual Enhancer' app (the folder containing start.bat), or its bin\runtime folder. Used whenever a node's runtime_dir is left empty.

widgets.name: DLSS5LivePreview
widgets.description: Live before/after MJPEG preview with wipe, transport and scrubber for the DLSS 5 Live Preview node.

metadata.description: Start here: how to set up and use the DLSS 5 Neural Rendering library, step by step.
Run a video (or one preview frame) through DLSS 5 Neural Rendering with intensity / tone / structure / skin controls and optional 1.5x-3x DLSS Super Resolution.

Loop a clip through the native DLSS 5 worker and adjust tone / structure / skin / style live with a before-after wipe; Bake renders the full clip to the project's outputs. Uses the bundled native worker with the DLLs from a DLSS 5 Visual Enhancer install.
